name: demoscene_palette_cycler
promptTemplate: A nostalgic 90s pixel art landscape featuring {{palette_theme}} lighting, {{cycle_speed}} water rush speed, {{torch_glow}} torch flicker intensity, and {{sky_style}} skies.

palette_theme.hint: Rotates VGA color tables across cliffs and waters

sky_style.hint: Swaps the horizon gradient and celestial glow

cycle_speed.hint: Speeds up waterfall cascade and lake ripples

torch_glow.hint: Sets brazier flicker frequency and radius

gallery.blurb: Colour cycling in the manner of 90s pixel art: a waterfall, a lake and flickering torches animated purely by rotating palette ranges over an indexed scene drawn once.
gallery.prompt: Colour cycling in the manner of 90s pixel art: a waterfall, a lake and flickering torches animated purely by rotating palette ranges over an indexed scene drawn once. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
